source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.2「夜間飛行」(1)夜間飛行と昼間飛行の違い

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 夜間は地上障害物等を視認できるよう地上照明を確保する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 機体灯火だけ見えれば地上環境の視認性は不要である。
evidence.reasoning_path: night visibility loss -> ground obstacle visibility -> provide ground lighting

collision.note: LOW。Q063は夜間非対応vision sensor、B2 C020はhuman visual limitationであり、ground lighting requirementは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.2 requires ground lighting so takeoff/landing, emergency sites and route obstacles remain visible at night; distinct from Q063 vision-sensor limitations and B2 night human factors.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
